konfig.config.battlepumpkins.title: Battle Pumpkins
battlepumpkins.config.info.title: Battle Pumpkins
battlepumpkins.config.info.body: Wild pumpkins hop around at night and sleep through the day disguised as pumpkin blocks. Catch one with shears, carve its face, and put a torch inside.
battlepumpkins.config.info.hint: These settings decide when wild ones show up. Hover a setting to see what it changes.
battlepumpkins.config.option.spawning.in: Wild Battle Pumpkins spawn on grass near players at night. At sunrise they settle down and pass for ordinary pumpkins.
battlepumpkins.config.option.off_season_: Outside Halloween week, an occasional wild pumpkin still turns up at night. Turn this off to keep them for Halloween only.
battlepumpkins.config.option.halloween_e: From October 25 to 30, many more wild pumpkins come out at night. On October 31, every one is already carved and lit. Dates follow the server's clock.
battlepumpkins.config.option.force_event: Runs Halloween week or Lantern Night now, whatever the date. Handy for servers, events, and videos.
Lots of plain wild pumpkins every night.
Every wild pumpkin comes already carved and lit. Some burn with green witch light, which you can only get this way.
